message: Last week, we had a surprise blackout, and my friend Sarah was in full-on panic mode, running around looking for candles. I calmly reached for my trusty flashlight and power bank, reminding her that we could still enjoy a cozy evening with some snacks and our phones charged. It’s funny how having a little backup plan can turn a stressful moment into an unexpected adventure. Have you ever had a friend who just can't handle the unexpected? What do you do to stay calm in those situations?
